review_body.en: I received the Apex X600 last week and it has exceeded every expectation. The cable management is pristine, the cooling keeps everything whisper quiet even under heavy load, and the overall build quality is top-notch. I've been running 4K games and video editing software without any hiccups. The attention to detail in this build is truly remarkable — from the RGB synchronization to the perfectly applied thermal paste. Highly recommend nubuilds to anyone looking for a premium custom PC.
